chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from al-Qasim, from 'Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:
We entered upon Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, and Abu Basir said to him: What do you say regarding the salat (prayer) in Ramadan?

He said: Indeed, Ramadan has a sanctity and a right unlike anything from the other months. Pray as much voluntary salat (prayer) as you are able in Ramadan, by night and day. And if you are able to pray one thousand rak'ahs each day, then pray. Indeed, 'Ali عليه السلام, in the latter part of his life, would pray one thousand rak'ahs in every day and night. And pray extra in Ramadan, O Aba Muhammad.

He said: How much, may I be your ransom? He said: During the twenty nights that pass, in every night twenty rak'ahs: eight rak'ahs before al-'atamah and twelve after it, besides what you used to pray before that.
Then when the last ten nights begin, pray thirty rak'ahs every night: eight rak'ahs before al-'atamah and twenty-two after al-'atamah, besides what you used to do before that.

key_terms.الْعَتَمَةِ: The night prayer time, referring here to the 'Isha' period.
key_terms.الْعَشْرُ الْأَوَاخِرُ: The last ten nights of Ramadan, marked by increased devotional prayer.
key_terms.تَطَوُّعًا: Voluntary devotional prayer beyond obligatory salat.
key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: The month of Ramadan, distinguished here by special sanctity and devotional merit.
key_terms.لَحُرْمَةً: A sacred inviolability or sanctity possessed by Ramadan.

ai.seo_question: What extra salat (prayer) is recommended in Ramadan according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the recommended increase of voluntary salat (prayer) during the month of Ramadan due to its unique sanctity and right. It specifies a structured pattern of additional nightly prayers for the first twenty nights and for the last ten nights, while also citing the great devotion of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام.
